title: Maria's Shopping List
text:
Maria makes a shopping list every Saturday. She writes the list on paper before she goes to the supermarket. Today the list has bread, milk, eggs, and apples. Maria always checks the list before she pays.

At the supermarket, Maria finds all the things on her list. She buys the apples last because they are heavy. Then she goes home and puts the food in the fridge. She feels happy because she did not forget anything.

questions.text: What does Maria write her list on?
Why does Maria write a list before she goes shopping?
options: She does not like the supermarket.
She wants to buy only apples.
She wants to pay more money.
She wants to remember what to buy.

questions.text: What can we infer about Maria's shopping trip?
options: She bought everything she planned to buy.
She forgot most of the food.
She went to a different store.
She spent less money than usual.

vocabulary.definition: a set of things written down so you remember them
a large shop that sells food and other goods

paragraph_translations: Maria faz uma lista de compras todo sábado. Ela escreve a lista no papel antes de ir ao supermercado. Hoje a lista tem pão, leite, ovos e maçãs. Maria sempre verifica a lista antes de pagar.

No supermercado, Maria encontra todas as coisas da sua lista. Ela compra as maçãs por último porque elas são pesadas. Depois ela vai para casa e coloca a comida na geladeira. Ela fica feliz porque não esqueceu nada.
